excerpt.zh: 优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
excerpt.en: Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

texts.zh: 优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
texts.en: Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

label.zh: 确保我们所有的子个体都有保护。
label.en: Ensure all our drones are shielded.

texts.zh:
状态更新：数据确认[root.GetStarName]已经进入了一个剧烈活动的阶段，其特点是恒星黑子增加、日冕物质抛射以及磁爆发。我们的[Root.owner.GetScientistPlural]估计这颗恒星会在五年内恢复到正常的活动水平。

建议行动计划：继续生产防辐射部件以保护我们的无人机在风暴结束之前不受损伤。
texts.en:
Status update: data confirms [root.GetStarName] has entered a phase of intense activity, characterized by increased solar spots, coronal mass ejections, and magnetic outbursts. Our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] estimate the star will return to a normal level of activity within five years.

Suggested plan of action: continue to produce radiation-hardened components to shield our drones from radiation damage until the storm subsides.

texts.zh: 先导性分析表明，沉迷于活体陈设将对他们的自我价值感产生积极影响，但也可能使他们面临无法预料的危险。
texts.en: Pre-emptive analysis suggests indulging the bio-trophies will have a positive impact on their sense of self-worth, but may also expose them to unforeseen dangers.

texts.zh:
状态报告：[Target.GetName]上的辐射水平已经趋于稳定。[Target.GetStarName]已恢复到正常的恒星活动水平。地磁风暴已经结束。

最终报告：这一挑战性的局势给予我们一个完善防辐射技术的机遇，提升了我们无人机在极端条件下生存的能力。感激这一结果。
texts.en:
Status report: radiation levels on [Target.GetName] are now stable. [Target.GetStarName] has returned to normal levels of solar activity. The geomagnetic storm has ended.

Final report: the challenging situation gave us an opportunity to perfect our radiation-hardening techniques, increasing our drones' capabilities to survive in extreme conditions. We appreciate this outcome.

texts.zh:
状态报告：[Target.GetName]上的辐射水平已经趋于稳定。[Target.GetStarName]已恢复到正常的恒星活动水平。地磁风暴已经结束。

最终报告：我们疲于应对风暴，最后还是没能保护我们的无人机不受辐射损伤。尽管我们从挑战中生存下来，但我们也找到了提升的空间。
texts.en:
Status report: radiation levels on [Target.GetName] are now stable. [Target.GetStarName] has returned to normal levels of solar activity. The geomagnetic storm has ended.

Final report: we struggled to deal with the storm, and failed to protect our drones from radiation damage. While we were able to survive the challenge, we see room for improvement.

texts.zh:
状态报告：[Target.GetName]上的辐射水平已经趋于稳定。[Target.GetStarName]已恢复到正常的恒星活动水平。地磁风暴已经结束。

最终报告：我们仍在遭受辐射损伤的后续影响。还需要一定时间恢复到理想的认知状态。令人不满的结果。我们在未来必须多家准备。
texts.en:
Status report: radiation levels on [Target.GetName] are now stable. [Target.GetStarName] has returned to normal levels of solar activity. The geomagnetic storm has ended.

Final report: we are still suffering from long-lasting consequences of radiation damage. Returning to an optimal cognitive state will require time. Unsatisfying outcome. We must be better prepared for the future.

texts.zh: 信息：尽管我们不再需要生物助手的服务，但我们的活体人口已经变得非常适应这一角色。他们似乎很享受承担责任的机会。如何继续？
texts.en: Information: while the services of our Bio-Assistants are no longer required, our bio-pops have grown rather attached to their role. It seems they relish the chance to hold responsibility. How to proceed?

label.en: Let the Bio-Assistants keep their playground.

texts.zh:
一场恒星活动的激增正在削弱[Target.GetName]的磁层，将我们的机械暴露在危险量级的电离辐射中。投资辐射抵抗技术可以保护我们的子个体在风暴结束之前免受损伤。
该局势会在[Target.storm_duration]月之内结束。
texts.en:
An increase in solar activity is weakening [Target.GetName]'s magnetosphere, exposing our machines to dangerous levels of ionizing radiation. Invest in radiation hardening techniques to shield our drones against damage until the storm subsides.
The situation will end in [Target.storm_duration] month(s).
